name: Little Falls Summer Camp
operator_name: Township of Little Falls Recreation Department
description_short: Township recreation day camp in Little Falls for children in pre-K through grade 6, open to residents and non-residents, with games, sports, crafts, special events and optional field trips. Families pick and pay for single weeks.

fees.name: After care (2 to 5 pm, grades 1 to 6)
Field trip
fees.note: Each trip $50 or $60 per child, 40 spots per trip, by grade; registered separately.

notes: Weekly rate $175 for grades 1 to 6 (9 am to 2 pm) and $100 for pre-K and kindergarten (9 am to noon); the page names no separate resident rate. Up to 150 campers a week. Registration opened March 30, 2026 on Community Pass. Session price is the grades 1 to 6 weekly rate.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. 2026 camp page: June 29 to August 7, 2026, open to residents and non-residents. ZIP is the township's (225 Main Street, Little Falls, NJ 07424, in the page footer); the camp site is not named
